# speckit hook

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Claude Code hook-adapter subcommand family (feature 022, ADR-0043): reads one host hook event payload from stdin, answers in that host's own protocol

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit hook <COMMAND>
```
